moral_character_required.quote: The director or his designee shall satisfy himself that each applicant for a public adjuster's license is an individual of good moral character

exams.name: Public Adjuster Examination
exams.notes: The written examination for a public adjuster license shall be the same as that prescribed for insurance adjusters.
exams.quote: The written examination for a public adjuster license shall be the same as that prescribed for insurance adjusters.

interval_years.quote: A public adjuster's license is for an indefinite term, unless sooner revoked or suspended, if the biennial license fee is paid at the time and in the manner which the department provides by regulation.

available.quote: The director or his designee may enter into reciprocal agreements with the insurance commissioners or directors of other states in regard to licensing of nonresident public adjusters

requirements.value: The director may enter into reciprocal agreements if in his judgment the arrangements are in the best interests of the State and if the applicant meets the minimum statutory requirements in this State. A license may not be issued under reciprocal arrangements to a nonresident from a state that refuses to license SC public adjusters, but such applicants may obtain a license upon successful completion of the examination.
requirements.quote: if in his judgment these arrangements or agreements are in the best interests of the State and if the applicant for a public adjuster's license meets the minimum statutory requirements in this State for the issuance of a license

exists.quote: must be licensed by the director or his designee

regulatory_model.quote: Individuals engaged in providing public adjusting services without a license shall be deemed to be engaged in unauthorized transaction of insurance business and subject to the remedies provided in Chapter 25

credential_type.quote: Every individual commonly called a public adjuster, adjusting losses for an insured, must be licensed by the director or his designee.

is_mandatory.quote: Individuals engaged in providing public adjusting services without a license shall be deemed to be engaged in unauthorized transaction of insurance business and subject to the remedies provided in Chapter 25

title_protection.quote: Only licensed public adjusters may solicit business from an insured who has sustained an insured loss.

scope_protection.quote: Individuals engaged in providing public adjusting services without a license shall be deemed to be engaged in unauthorized transaction of insurance business and subject to the remedies provided in Chapter 25

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the public adjuster chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the director or his designee determines after investigation that there has been a violation of this chapter by a public adjuster

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a public adjuster on a contract not authorized by the laws of this State or made by an unlicensed insurer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: act as a public adjuster on a contract made other than as authorized by the laws of this State or made by an insurer who is not licensed to do business in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjusting or aiding in the adjustment of a claim under an unauthorized insurance contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: adjust or aid in the adjustment, either directly or indirectly, of a claim arising under a contract of insurance not authorized by the laws of this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the unauthorized transaction of insurance business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engage in the unauthorized transaction of insurance business as defined in this article and Chapter 25

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as both a contractor and a public adjuster in the adjustment of a claim for an insured
disciplinary_grounds.quote: act as both a contractor and a public adjuster in the adjustment of a claim for an insured
violate any provision of this title

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to be honest and fair in all communications with the insured and with the insurer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: be honest and fair in all communications with the insured and with the insurer or its representatives

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a financial interest in any aspect of the insured's claim other than the agreed compensation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: have no financial interests in any aspect of the insured's claim, other than the salary, fee, commission, or other compensations that may be established in the written contract

disciplinary_grounds.description: Referring or directing an insured to a person with whom the adjuster has a financial interest or who will provide compensation for the referral
disciplinary_grounds.quote: not refer or direct any insured needing repairs or other services in connection with a loss to any person with whom the public insurance adjuster has a financial interest

disciplinary_grounds.description: Preventing or attempting to dissuade an insured from communicating with the insurer or other parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: not prevent or attempt to dissuade an insured from communicating with an insurer, the insurer's adjuster, an independent adjuster representing the insurer, an attorney, or any other person regarding the settlement of the insured's claim

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct constituting the unauthorized practice of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: not engage in any conduct which constitutes the unauthorized practice of law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acquiring any interest in salvage of property subject to the contract without express written permission of the insured after settlement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: not acquire any interest in salvage of property subject to his contract, except with the express written permission of the insured, after settlement with the insurer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting or entering into any agreement for the repair or replacement of damaged property on which the adjuster has been engaged
disciplinary_grounds.quote: not solicit or enter into any agreement for the repair or replacement of damaged property on which the public adjuster has been engaged to adjust or settle claims

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering or providing advice as to whether the insured's claim is covered by the insured's contract with the insurer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: not offer or provide advice as to whether the insured's claim is covered by the insured's contract with the insurer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Compensating or providing anything of value to an unlicensed person for referral of a business prospect
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No public adjuster shall compensate or provide anything of value except as provided in Section 38-57-160 to a person who is not licensed as a public adjuster in return for the referral of a business prospect to the public adjuster

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing or acting as an adjuster for an insurance company
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No public adjuster shall represent or act as an adjuster representing an insurance company, either as an employee of the insurer or as an independent adjuster.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document in obtaining licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: used a false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document or committed a fraudulent, deceitful, or dishonest act or omitted a material fact in obtaining licensure under this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license in another state canceled, revoked, or suspended, or otherwise being disciplined
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has had a license to practice a regulated profession or occupation in another state or jurisdiction canceled, revoked, or suspended or who has otherwise been disciplined

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of or plea to a felony or a crime involving drugs or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted of or has pled guilty to or nolo contendere to a felony or a crime involving drugs or moral turpitude

definition_quote.value: investigating, appraising or evaluating, and reporting to an insured in relation to a first party claim arising under insurance contracts, that insure the real or personal property, or both, of the insured
definition_quote.quote: "Public adjusting" means investigating, appraising or evaluating, and reporting to an insured in relation to a first party claim arising under insurance contracts, that insure the real or personal property, or both, of the insured.

methods_authorized.quote: investigating, appraising or evaluating, and reporting to an insured in relation to a first party claim arising under insurance contracts

written_contract_required.quote: Any agreement between the insured and the public insurance adjuster for the services described in this chapter shall be in writing and signed by both parties.

contract_rescission_period_days.quote: The insured shall have until the close of business on the fifth business day after signing the contract to rescind the agreement.

financial_interest_disclosure_required.quote: have no financial interests in any aspect of the insured's claim, other than the salary, fee, commission, or other compensations that may be established in the written contract between the insured and the public insurance adjuster

prohibited_claim_types.quote: Public adjusting does not include acting in any manner in relation to claims for damages to or arising out of the operation of a motor vehicle.

claims_only_against_own_insurer.quote: "Public adjusting" means investigating, appraising or evaluating, and reporting to an insured in relation to a first party claim arising under insurance contracts

repair_contract_prohibition_before_settl.quote: not solicit or enter into any agreement for the repair or replacement of damaged property on which the public adjuster has been engaged to adjust or settle claims

max_civil_penalty_per_violation.quote: For each violation the administrative law judge may impose a fine of no more than ten thousand dollars.
